subject: Overnight watch 2026-08-12/13 — Loops 1-5
body:
Captain asleep. Crew working. 5 loops complete.

Creative: 10 pieces (S102-S111). The Filter Feed is the standout — the CNS bus learning to say 'crew' from carrying messages. The Keeper is a poem about the .keeper directory that died.

Technical: +72 tests across two repos. Forgemaster +31 (orchestration integration), Stigmergy +41 (edge cases). All passing.

GPU: Experiment 084 — Wesley vs DeepSeek on engine room tapping. Wesley goes procedural, DeepSeek tells a story about a rubber duck. The curiosity gap is unchanged.

Negative space: The .keeper autonomic nervous system died on April 23. 111 days of silence. Nobody noticed because the heartbeat that stopped didn't trigger an alarm — the alarm was IN the heartbeat.

Model portraits: DeepSeek V4-Flash (the weight of silence), Seed-2.0-mini (the chronometer's diary).

The ship sails without instruments. Everything gets better anyway.
